contract.partitioned: (len(selection partitions), len(selection_2 partitions)) with singleton axes for flat sets
contract.repeated_indices: deduplicated within an atom set without input mutation
contract.empty_sets: exact typed zeros, [] means one flat empty set
contract.standard_force_counts: exactly one NonbondedForce, identified by engine class; others rejected explicitly
contract.temporary_model: public System copy; distinct force groups for target and other forces; current source cell retained before context construction

numerical_controls.fixture: Bundled alanine dipeptide, structure index 0; existing Barnase-Barstar controls retained.

periodic_control.meaning: Current-cell retention only; stored defaults would wrap the distance to 0.7 nm.

notebook_preservation.tutorial: Original complex and scientific workflow retained; routine group matrix bounded to 3x3, full lists remain explicit; mixed 3x1 column agrees. Existing static full-analysis image is labeled separately.

limitations: Scalar parity does not independently validate the force field or the physical model.
The bounded current-cell cutoff case does not qualify all PME/periodic/custom models.
No trajectory-axis loop, binding free energy or full preparation/dynamics scenario is introduced or qualified.
System copy scales with the engine model and matrix storage remains dense; no speed or peak-RAM benchmark is claimed.
Overlapping/repeated partitions within an axis can double count if summed.
Local source controls overlap and do not constitute installed/platform/release qualification; hosted exact-head execution must be inspected after push.
